title: WASM in Depth
concept: Deep dive into WebAssembly with XIOM — complex interop patterns, performance optimization, WASI, and deploying XIOM applications to the web.
why: WASM brings XIOM to the browser. Understanding the full WASM ecosystem enables you to build web apps, NPM packages, and edge computing services in XIOM.
tips: Keep WASM ↔ JS calls minimal — batch operations on the WASM side for performance
wasm-bindgen auto-generates TypeScript types — your JS gets type-checking for free
WASM threads are limited — use Web Workers or SharedArrayBuffer for parallelism
Test WASM in all target browsers — Firefox, Chrome, Safari have subtle WASM differences
common_mistakes: Calling WASM functions in tight JS loops — the boundary crossing dominates runtime
Forgetting that WASM has a separate memory space — you can't pass JS objects directly
Assuming WASM has DOM access — it doesn't, all DOM operations go through JS
